title: BEACON Threshold Rule (FR-11 early-warning)
description: Validates a declarative FR-11 threshold rule (ADR-014; CLARIFICATIONS §B.Q5; SPEC §5.3; DOMAIN_MODEL §2 THRESHOLD_RULE). Rules are evaluated each ingestion cycle over the canonical model; an edge-triggered transition across 'value' creates a DRAFT ALERT with provenance to the triggering SOURCE_RECORD. No CAP is emitted until a VERIFIER approves (Art. XIII). Evaluation is deterministic and unit-testable. 'hysteresis' (min dwell) is anti-flap; 'cooldown' de-dups repeat fires.

id.description: Stable rule id (DOMAIN_MODEL THRESHOLD_RULE.id). Set on a fired ALERT.threshold_rule_id for EV6 traceability.

target.description: What the rule observes in the canonical model (DOMAIN_MODEL THRESHOLD_RULE.target). GAUGE_CATEGORY = a flood gauge's category; HAZARD_BUFFER = a hazard polygon entering an infrastructure buffer.

operator.description: Transition operator (edge-triggered, SPEC §5.3). 'crosses' = transitions across 'value' (used with GAUGE_CATEGORY ordering); 'gte' = reaches/exceeds a numeric 'value'; 'enters' = enters a buffer/zone of type 'value' (used with HAZARD_BUFFER).

value.description: The threshold the target transitions across (SPEC §5.3). Per target: a flood-category enum (NONE|ACTION|MINOR|MODERATE|MAJOR) for GAUGE_CATEGORY/crosses; a distance/stage in meters for gte; an infrastructure type for HAZARD_BUFFER/enters. Accepts a string token or a non-negative number.

scope.description: Region this rule applies to (DOMAIN_MODEL THRESHOLD_RULE.scope = region_id; per-region configurability, ADR-014). FK -> region.id.

hysteresis.description: Minimum dwell the new state must hold before firing (anti-flap, SPEC §5.3). Duration token: digits + unit s|m|h (e.g. '15m', '300s', '1h').

cooldown.description: De-dup window suppressing repeat fires after one fire (SPEC §5.3). Duration token: digits + unit s|m|h (e.g. '60m', '3600s', '2h').

enabled.description: Optional active flag; when absent the rule is treated as enabled. Lets a rule be staged/disabled per region without deletion.
